_comment: MCP server registry, mirroring ~/.claude/mcp.json on the source machine. Copy to ~/.claude/mcp.json on the new Mac. As of the 2026-08-13 snapshot this file carries NO secrets — the only locally-registered server is stdio-launched via npx. If you later add an HTTP server with an Authorization header, redact the token here as REDACTED_PUT_<NAME>_TOKEN_HERE and keep the live value in your password manager.
_history: A self-hosted n8n HTTP MCP server was registered here until 2026-07-04. It is gone from live config and has been dropped from this template; re-add it by hand (URL + Bearer JWT from the password manager) if you bring it back.
